long_biography.plain_text:
Magda Abdel Aziz Taha occupies a place in the ownership chain behind ADES, an Egyptian-founded drilling company that developed into an international operator. At its London flotation, ADES Investments was the controlling shareholder, with Intro Investments representing the Abbas family's majority interest in that holding vehicle.

The structure endured through ADES's later Saudi listing. Taha held 17 per cent of Intro Investments. Through linked holding companies, Intro retained a majority interest in ADES Investments, which was itself the drilling group's controlling shareholder before the offering. Taha's ownership remained one step above ADES Investments within the private holding structure.

Shared addresses, joint administration and adjacent shareholdings are not treated as proof of a legal family relationship or wealth-transfer route.
